targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS events FROM cart_events_storage WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)

panels.title: Phiên hoạt động (1 phút gần nhất)

targets.rawSql: SELECT uniqExact(session_id) AS sessions FROM cart_events_storage WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 1 MINUTE

panels.title: Tỷ lệ chuyển đổi (xem → thanh toán)

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(uniqExactIf(session_id, action = 'CHECKOUT') * 100 / nullIf(uniqExactIf(session_id, action = 'VIEW_PRODUCT'), 0), 2) AS conversion FROM cart_events_storage WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
SELECT sum(price * quantity) AS revenue FROM cart_events_storage WHERE action = 'CHECKOUT' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)

panels.title: Sự kiện theo thời gian (theo loại hành động)

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(timestamp) AS time, action, count() AS events FROM cart_events_storage WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY time, action ORDER BY time

SELECT '1. Xem sản phẩm' AS stage, uniqExactIf(session_id, action = 'VIEW_PRODUCT') AS sessions FROM cart_events_storage WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) UNION ALL SELECT '2. Thêm vào giỏ', uniqExactIf(session_id, action = 'ADD_TO_CART') FROM cart_events_storage WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) UNION ALL SELECT '3. Thanh toán', uniqExactIf(session_id, action = 'CHECKOUT') FROM cart_events_storage WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)

panels.title: Top 10 sản phẩm bị bỏ giỏ nhiều nhất

targets.rawSql: SELECT product_id, countIf(action = 'ADD_TO_CART') AS adds, countIf(action = 'REMOVE_FROM_CART') AS removes, countIf(action = 'CHECKOUT') AS purchases, round(removes * 100 / nullIf(adds, 0), 1) AS remove_rate_pct, round((adds - purchases) * 100 / nullIf(adds, 0), 1) AS abandon_rate_pct FROM cart_events_storage WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY product_id HAVING adds >= 3 ORDER BY (adds - purchases) DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Top 10 sản phẩm theo doanh thu (VND)

targets.rawSql: SELECT product_id, sum(price * quantity) AS revenue FROM cart_events_storage WHERE action = 'CHECKOUT' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY product_id ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Giỏ hàng bị bỏ quên (chưa thanh toán, im lặng > 30 giây) - ứng viên gửi voucher

targets.rawSql: SELECT session_id, any(user_id) AS user_id, sum(if(action = 'ADD_TO_CART', quantity * price, 0)) - sum(if(action = 'REMOVE_FROM_CART', quantity * price, 0)) AS cart_value_vnd, max(timestamp) AS last_seen, dateDiff('second', max(timestamp), now()) AS idle_seconds FROM cart_events_storage WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY session_id HAVING countIf(action = 'CHECKOUT') = 0 AND cart_value_vnd > 0 AND idle_seconds > 30 ORDER BY cart_value_vnd DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Số giỏ hàng bị bỏ quên

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS abandoned_carts FROM (SELECT session_id, sum(if(action = 'ADD_TO_CART', quantity * price, 0)) - sum(if(action = 'REMOVE_FROM_CART', quantity * price, 0)) AS cart_value, max(timestamp) AS last_seen, countIf(action = 'CHECKOUT') AS paid FROM cart_events_storage WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY session_id) WHERE paid = 0 AND cart_value > 0 AND dateDiff('second', last_seen, now()) > 30

panels.title: Giá trị hàng bị bỏ quên (VND)

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(cart_value) AS abandoned_value FROM (SELECT session_id, sum(if(action = 'ADD_TO_CART', quantity * price, 0)) - sum(if(action = 'REMOVE_FROM_CART', quantity * price, 0)) AS cart_value, max(timestamp) AS last_seen, countIf(action = 'CHECKOUT') AS paid FROM cart_events_storage WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY session_id) WHERE paid = 0 AND cart_value > 0 AND dateDiff('second', last_seen, now()) > 30
